kpis.description_fr: Regulatory Capital Value (RCV) Ofwat. KPI fondamental utility eau UK régulée. Croissance liée au programme d'investissement AMP. Driver direct de l'allowed return.
kpis.description_en: Regulatory Capital Value (RCV) per Ofwat. Fundamental UK regulated water utility KPI. Growth tied to AMP investment program. Direct allowed return driver.

kpis.description_fr: Capex régulé annuel. AMP7 (2020-2025) = 3,2 G£, AMP8 (2025-2030) annoncé à 13,7 G£ (+88 %). Investissements infrastructure eau + traitement post-Brexit.
kpis.description_en: Annual regulated capex. AMP7 (2020-2025) = £3.2B, AMP8 (2025-2030) announced at £13.7B (+88%). Water + treatment infrastructure investment post-Brexit.

kpis.description_fr: Récompenses Outcome Delivery Incentives Ofwat (bonus performance leakage, supply interruption, water quality). Volatil selon performance. UU historiquement net positif vs peers.
kpis.description_en: Ofwat Outcome Delivery Incentives rewards (performance bonus on leakage, supply interruption, water quality). Volatile by performance. UU historically net positive vs peers.

kpis.description_fr: Fuites totales réseau distribution (megalitres/jour). Cible Ofwat AMP7 = réduction 15 %. KPI grand public sensible et lié ODI.
kpis.description_en: Total distribution network leakage (megaliters/day). Ofwat AMP7 target = 15% reduction. Sensitive public-facing KPI tied to ODI.

_notes: United Utilities : KPIs utility eau UK régulée Ofwat (RCV, capex AMP, ODI, leakage). AMP8 (2025-2030) capex x2 = forte visibilité long-terme.
